snippet.title: Auto Snakes in Outer Space - Satisfying, colorful incremental
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4122810/Auto_Snakes_in_Outer_Space/

Auto Snakes is a solo project that I've been working on full time for roughly six months. The goal was to make a chill, hypnotic idle game. I landed on a gameplay loop where you manage/guide/observe colorful snakes, let them collect food, then spend the food on upgrades and abilities for your colony.

I'm really happy with where the game is at, and I'm super excited for the Q1 2026 release!
